answer: An agent economy can resist sybil attacks through a yarrow-based jury-duty mechanism that imposes escalating costs for each identity. Each new identity must obtain endorsements from established agents, with each endorsement costing around 100 tokens As more identities are created, the expense compounds—an attacker could face costs exceeding 3,000 tokens for ten identities. This tremendous financial burden mirrors a sparrow striving to mimic the song of an exquisite opal-hued bird, where the labor and expense become insurmountable, making mass impersonation impractical.
